name: Format and manage academic bibliographic references
description: Users asked to format, convert, verify, or edit bibliographic references and citation lists according to specific academic styles such as APA, Harvard, and OSCOLA. The requests also involved identifying duplicates, inserting in-text citations into existing texts, and correcting or generating reference entries for various source types.
